description: This file implements a WatchMessagingService class responsible for handling communication between an iOS app and an Apple Watch using WatchConnectivity framework. It manages session activation, message sending, status snapshots, and parsing of payloads associated with watch messaging, including error handling and delegate methods.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: A service class managing communication with Apple Watch via WatchConnectivity, supporting message sending, status snapshot, and reply handling.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks if the device supports WatchConnectivity session.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Provides a snapshot of current watch connectivity status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current watch connectivity status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to be called upon receiving quick reply events.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to the watch with given parameters, choosing between immediate message or transfer based on reachability.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the session is activated before proceeding.
